elements.requirement: Section 108 of the Housing Act 2004 applies to any interest or right created by the local housing authority under section 107(3)(c).
elements.quote: This section applies in relation to any interest or right created by the authority under section 107(3)(c).

elements.requirement: For the purposes of any enactment or rule of law, any interest created by the authority under section 107(3)(c)(i) must be treated as if it were a legal lease, notwithstanding that the authority holds no legal estate in the premises.
elements.quote: any interest created by the authority under section 107(3)(c)(i) is to be treated as if it were a legal lease

elements.requirement: For the purposes of any enactment or rule of law, any right created by the authority under section 107(3)(c)(ii) must be treated as if it were a licence to occupy granted by the legal owner of the premises, notwithstanding that the authority holds no legal estate in the premises.
elements.quote: any right created by the authority under section 107(3)(c)(ii) is to be treated as if it were a licence to occupy granted by the legal owner of the premises, despite the fact that the authority have no legal estate in the premises

elements.requirement: Any enactment or rule of law concerning landlords and tenants or leases applies to any interest created by the authority under section 107(3)(c)(i) as if the authority were the legal owner of the premises.
elements.quote: Any enactment or rule of law relating to landlords and tenants or leases accordingly applies in relation to any interest created by the authority under section 107(3)(c)(i) as if the authority were the legal owner of the premises.

elements.requirement: Where the context permits, references to leases and licences in this Chapter and in any other enactment include interests and rights created by the authority under section 107(3)(c).
elements.quote: References to leases and licences— (a) in this Chapter, and (b) in any other enactment, accordingly include (where the context permits) interests and rights created by the authority under section 107(3)(c).

elements.requirement: The provisions of section 108(1) to (4) have effect subject to section 124(7) to (9).
elements.quote: The preceding provisions of this section have effect subject to— (a) section 124(7) to (9)

elements.requirement: The provisions of section 108(1) to (4) have effect subject to any contrary provision contained in an order made by the appropriate national authority.
elements.quote: have effect subject to— (a) section 124(7) to (9), and (b) any provision to the contrary contained in an order made by the appropriate national authority.

elements.requirement: The reference to leasing in section 107(5)(b) does not include the creation of interests by the authority under section 107(3)(c)(i).
elements.quote: In section 107(5)(b) the reference to leasing does not include the creation of interests under section 107(3)(c)(i).

elements.requirement: In section 108, the term 'enactment' carries the meaning given to it by section 107(11).
elements.quote: “enactment” has the meaning given by section 107(11)

elements.requirement: In section 108, a 'legal lease' means a term of years absolute within the meaning of section 1(1)(b) of the Law of Property Act 1925 (c. 20).
elements.quote: “legal lease” means a term of years absolute (within section 1(1)(b) of the Law of Property Act 1925 (c. 20)).
